subject: hbase input feature ready for early testing

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: hbase input feature ready for early testing
parts:
Hi,
if you have data in HBase on which you would like to run mapreduce jobs written in R with rmr, please get in touch with me. The hbase-io branch adds an input format called hbase that allows you to do just that and I've just taken it through the first small test runs. This is way not ready for production, but we need your help to further develop this feature. What are you trying to do with the data and how is it serialized? The corresponding output format is in the works but is a little further down the road. Thanks


Antonio
